headline: World Bank Warns Pakistan Faces Elevated Financial Sector Risks
summary: The World Bank warned that Pakistan faces elevated financial sector risks due to heavy reliance on domestic banks for government financing and persistent macro-fiscal imbalances.
why: Sovereign debt exposure and banking sector vulnerabilities in emerging economies affect sovereign credit ratings and domestic lending capacity.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Elevated financial sector risks raise systemic concerns for domestic economic stability.
